text: The Lamenters may be the unluckiest Chapter in the Imperium.
Sons of the Blood Angels, they carry their father's curse, and misfortune follows them everywhere.
When the Tyrant of Badab rose against the Imperium, the Lamenters believed his cause was just.
They fought their loyal brothers, and they lost.
They were spared, but stripped of their relics, and sent on a hundred-year penitent crusade.
Hive Fleet Kraken devoured world after world, and the Lamenters stood in its path.
When it was over, only a few hundred remained.
Their very name means mourning, and they have never stopped.
